name.en: Shay li-llāh yā Ramaḍān - Grant us for Allah's sake, O Ramadan

ara: شَيْء لِلَّهِ يَا رَمَضَان، شَيْء لِلَّهِ يَا رَمَضَان
شَيْء لِلَّهِ يَا رَمَضَان، بِالْقَبُولِ وَالْغُفْرَانِ
يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ، يَا قَدِيمَ الْإِحْسَانِ
بَحْرُ جُودِكَ مَلْيَانُ، جُدْ لَنَا بِالْغُفْرَانِ
وَلَنَا ظَنٌّ فِيك، يَا رَجَاءَ أَهْلِ الْإِيمَانِ
لاَ تُخَيِّبْ رَاجِيْ تَحْتَ بَابِكْ لاَجِيْ
لَمْ يَزَلْ فِي الدّاجِيْ قَائِلاً يَا حَنَّانْ
وَالصّلاَةُ الدّائِمْ عَلَىَ النَّبِي بْنِ هَاشِمْ
عَدّ مَنْ هُوْ قَائِمْ بِالْعِبَادَةْ سَهْرَانْ
en: shay li-llāh yā Ramaḍān, shay li-llāh yā Ramaḍān
shay li-llāh yā Ramaḍān, bi-l-qabūli wa-l-ghufrāni
yā Ḥannān yā Mannān, yā Qadīma l-Iḥsāni
baḥru jūdika malyān, jud lanā bi-l-ghufrāni
rabbanā nastaʿfīka, rabbanā nastarḍīka
wa-lanā ẓannun fīka, yā rajā'a ahli l-īmāni
lā tukhayyib rājī taḥta bābik lājī
lam yazal fī al-dājī qāʾilan yā ḥannān
bi-n-nabiyyi l-ummī wa-Khadīja ummī
wa-l-Batūli l-Khatmi sayyidāti n-niswān
wa-s-ṣalāh al-dāʾim ʿalā al-nabī bin Hāshim
ʿad man huwa qāʾim bi-al-ʿibādah sahrān
O Ramadan, for the sake of Allah, O Ramadan,
O Ramadan, for the sake of Allah, with acceptance and forgiveness.
O Tenderly Compassionate, O Ever‑Bestowing, O Eternal Giver of kindness,
Your sea of generosity is overflowing—grant us Your forgiveness.
Our Lord, we seek Your pardon, Our Lord, we seek to please You.
We hold hope in You, refuge for the faithful hearts.
Do not disappoint one who hopes, who seeks refuge beneath Your door,
He has not ceased, in the dark night, saying: O Most Tenderly Merciful,
By the unlettered Prophet and Khadijah, Mother of Believers,
And the chaste Fatimah, leader of virtuous women.
And blessings perpetual upon the Prophet, son of Hashim,
As numerous as those who stand in worship, wakeful through the night.
